title: PAR-134 SECTIONOBJECT indicator-color DWG CMC name/book retention
scope: Retain optional CMC color-name and color-book-name strings at the existing SECTIONOBJECT indicator-color field
Emit named C0/C1/C2/C3 through the bounded R2007+ detached stream
Verify method/payload/flags, parser string retention, following geometry/handle alignment, copy/reset, and fail-before-output behavior

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: ODA §2.11 defines generic CMC name/book flags and optional TV strings. It does not specify SECTIONOBJECT-specific color semantics or establish producer-authored RGB/name behavior.

localSource.finding: The existing SECTIONOBJECT indicator-color path already uses readBoundedCmColor/putCmColor. It previously retained C2 RGB only and discarded CMC name/book strings. The typed model now appends and preserves both strings; the bounded reader captures them and the writer emits method-specific C0/C1/C2/C3 with optional strings.
localSource.compatibility: Two public strings were appended after the existing RGB companion, preserving earlier member offsets but changing DRW_SectionObject size. Downstream consumers must rebuild; no virtual method changed.

generatedControls.finding: Generated cases cover named C0 ByLayer, C1 ByBlock, C3 ACI, C2 black RGB, and nonzero C2 RGB. An independent bit walk verifies reserved index, method, payload, flags, and subsequent vertices; the production parser verifies each scalar/RGB/name/book value plus section-settings and following-handle alignment. Copy/assignment/reset and missing-detached-string fail-before-output controls pass.
generatedControls.limit: Generated vectors establish local codec consistency only. They are not producer-authored evidence for SECTIONOBJECT field semantics.

dxfMappingAudit.finding: The MLEADERSTYLE DXF reference documents its class-specific color fields as groups 91, 93, and 94 but gives no class-specific truecolor/name/book mapping. Generic entity color extensions were not assigned to these different fields by inference. This result does not resolve SECTIONOBJECT group 411.

productionSummary: Append indicator-color name/book fields and preserve them through copy/assignment/reset.
Capture optional CMC strings from the bounded detached string stream.
Write explicit C0/C1/C2/C3 method and optional strings through strBuf.
Refuse named output when the required detached stream is missing or aliases the body, before writing the common entity prefix.

unresolved: SECTIONOBJECT producer-authored CMC color semantics remain unqualified.
SECTIONOBJECT DXF group 411 meaning remains unresolved; no DWG CMC or generic group-code inference was made.
HATCH C5 producer semantics, the remaining CMC consumer audit, and native/external qualification remain open.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL.
